_comment: Recruits. tier: field (can fight on missions), core (deep bonds), recruit (light). Stats 1-10: might, craft, lore, charm, grit. start: in the roster on a new game. locked_party: always in the party (Ash). Traits are defined below. post: where they stand in Hollowmark when not governing, in the party or injured. look: paper-doll outfit and colors (placeholders until the PixelLab pass). lines: what they say when you talk to them in town. quips: one-liners for expedition reports.

greedy.name: Greedy
greedy.desc: Skims, but squeezes harder. +2 Gilt as governor.

stubborn.name: Stubborn
stubborn.desc: Will not give an inch. Governs with 1 more Fray resistance.

coward.name: Coward
coward.desc: Flees the edge. Governs with 1 less Fray resistance.

bookish.name: Bookish
bookish.desc: Happier with paper than people. Research later counts double.

ex_concord.name: Ex-Concord
ex_concord.desc: Knows the forms. The Concord hates them for it.

flirt.name: Flirt
flirt.desc: Charm counts double with envoys and in the tavern.

night_owl.name: Night Owl
night_owl.desc: Does their best work after dark.

ink_sick.name: Ink-sick
ink_sick.desc: The Blank got a taste once. Lore +2, but never fully well.

unwritten.name: Unwritten
unwritten.desc: No Ledger entry. The Blank treats them oddly. Leads every mission.

contract.name: Contracted
contract.desc: Paid by the job. Fights harder for coin, sulks without it.

recruits.name: Ash
recruits.title: the Unwritten
recruits.blurb: Spat back out by the Blank with no name, no voice and no Ledger entry. Everyone projects something different onto the silence.

recruits.name: Brannoc Coil
recruits.title: mercenary
recruits.blurb: His contract is tattooed on his arm and tightens if he breaks it. Will sell you out if outbid, and tells you so.
quips: Brannoc has submitted an invoice for "hazard, emotional".
Brannoc asks that it be noted he was "the competent one".
lines: Contract says I guard you. Doesn't say I have to like the town.
Point me at something and pay me. That's the whole relationship.
If someone offers me more, you'll hear it from me first. Professional courtesy.

recruits.name: Quill Marrow
recruits.title: quartermaster
recruits.blurb: Kept Hollowmark's books for the Concord. Now cooks them for you. Knows where every coin is buried, and who buried it.
quips: Quill kept receipts for everything, including the weather.
Quill has filed the trip under "deductible".
lines: Every coin in Hollowmark has a story. Most of them end with me.
The Concord taught me bookkeeping. I taught it creativity.
Ask me about the ledger. Actually, don't. Press L at the table.

recruits.name: Old Tobble
recruits.title: tavern keeper
recruits.blurb: Has been about to retire for thirty years. Hears everything; sells most of it.
quips: Tobble complained about his knees for the entire trip, then outran everyone.
Tobble sold the story to three different drinkers before the report was even written.
lines: Retiring next week. Have been since before your mother was written.
First drink's free. The second one costs you a secret.
People talk after dark. I listen. Then I charge.

recruits.name: Pell Undermoss
recruits.title: gravedigger
recruits.blurb: Digs too fast. Nobody has asked why the graves are always ready before anyone dies.
quips: Pell dug a hole at every campsite. Nobody asked what for. Nobody wanted to know.
Pell measured everyone on the way home. "Just in case."
lines: Dug three this morning. Nobody's died yet. Give it time.
The Blank doesn't leave bodies. Bad for business.
You've got a good shape for a grave. Compliment, that.

recruits.name: Mother Gristle
recruits.title: hedge-witch
recruits.blurb: Heals the party and bills them for it. Her poisons and her medicines are the same bottles.
quips: Mother Gristle has billed the squad for "moral support".
Mother Gristle collected some mushrooms. She says they are for cooking. She did not say whose.
lines: This one cures fever. Or causes it. Depends who's paying.
I bill by the wound. You look expensive.

recruits.name: Corporal Daro
recruits.title: "Ninefingers", deserter
recruits.blurb: Deserted the Concord army rather than strike out a village. Sharpest tongue in the Inklands.
quips: Daro saluted a scarecrow out of habit, then threatened it.
Daro wants it on record that the plan was bad and they followed it anyway.
lines: Lost the finger to a form. Long story. Paperwork was involved.
The Concord strikes out villages with a pen. I prefer the sword. More honest.

recruits.name: Sister Abeyance
recruits.title: runaway scribe
recruits.blurb: Ran from the Abbey with one stolen page that rewrites itself every night.
quips: Sister Abeyance's page rewrote itself as a shopping list. Everything on it was found.
Sister Abeyance says the trip was "very loud, in the quiet way".
lines: The page rewrote itself again. Last night it said your name. You don't have one.
Ink-sickness isn't so bad. The voices are mostly polite.
